caseNameFull: Realty Operators, Inc. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue William Henderson (Partnership) v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue and Williams, Liquidator v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: C. J. Batter for petitioners. Solicitor General McGrath, Assistant Attorney General McGregor, Sewall Key, Helen R. Carloss and Maryhelen Wigle for respondent. Briefs were filed by J. Sterling Halstead for the South Coast Corporation, and by Henry J. Richardson, as amici curiae, in support of the petition in No. 187.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

Reported below: No. 187, 153 F. 2d 551; No. 188,153 F. 2d 442; No. 189,153 F. 2d 547.
